narrative_purpose: Provide the chapter's full-bleed atmospheric mood layer: a layered sky of enormous depth that carries the feeling of a stacked, sheeted atmosphere while staying dark and quiet enough for long-form text to remain readable over it.
subject: No subject and no focal point at all. Endless flat cloud decks stacked one above another, each a dim horizontal sheet, receding layer after layer into depth. Each successive deck is fainter, lower in contrast and closer in value to the air around it than the one in front, so the eye finds nothing to settle on. A few very faint thin streaks of high cloud drawn out horizontally across the upper region, barely separable from the sky behind them.
scene: An ultra-wide panoramic view from a very high vantage over an open atmosphere. A barely-visible gently curved horizon sits low in the frame, its arc suggested only by a slight shift in value rather than any edge. Enormous atmospheric depth between the near decks and the far ones, everything dissolving progressively into haze. Completely empty of life.
camera: Extremely wide panoramic establishing view from very high altitude, level and static, horizon low, no foreground element.
light: Very flat, dim, sourceless ambient light with no visible sun, no rim-lighting and no bright highlight anywhere. A slight, even lift in brightness toward the distant horizon only.
palette: Void indigo and deep teal-indigo across nearly the whole frame, held dark and close in value; only the faintest desaturated mist grey in the far haze; no warm accent anywhere; no bioluminescent glow.
style: Painterly atmospheric mood layer, extremely soft, all edges dissolved, no crisp detail anywhere in the frame.
detail_level: Uniformly low detail throughout — deliberately soft and unresolved everywhere, with no sharp region and no rendered focal element.
composition: Broad horizontal bands of dim cloud filling the frame, the whole image kept dark, even and low-contrast so that long passages of overlaid body text stay fully readable across every part of it. No bright patch, no strong value jump, no busy texture, nothing that competes with foreground text anywhere.
consistency_notes: This is a background plate, not an illustration: absolutely no creatures, no figures and no focal subject of any kind.
